content.what_it_is: MATLAB script 'IG component generation for FUNWAVE wind wave and IG wave input' (header L1-L14, Fengyan Shi 04/06/2021) in the simple_cases/IG_waves/2_wave_components example. Inputs from Step_1_read_write_spec.m: SPC_dep_pf.txt (depth h and peak frequency, L23-L25), SPC_frq.txt (frequencies @L27), SPC_angle.txt (single angle @L29), SPC_HMO.txt (component Hmo values @L30, comment 'amp in the example is 0.5m, Hmo is 1.4142'); declared output 'spectrum_random_phase.txt' @L12 but the actual file written is 'spectrum_two_components.txt' @L88. Steps: amplitudes Amp_each=sqrt(2)/4*spc' @L34; angular frequencies Omega_each=2*pi*fre @L36; reproducible random phases via rng(1) @L39 and Phi_each=2*pi*rand(...) @L40. Subharmonic (bound IG) components: for every pair (i,j), i<j (L47-L77), computes difference frequency fnm=diff(f) @L54, wavenumbers k=wvnum_omvec(h,omega,g) @L58 (external function), knm=diff(k) @L60, and second-order interaction coefficient C @L62 and Dnm (L64-L66, Longuet-Higgins/Stewart-type bound-wave transfer with resonant denominator g*knm*tanh(knm*h)-(omega1-omega2)^2), giving bound amplitude anm=Dnm*a(1)*a(2) @L68 with difference phase PHI_nm=Phi_each(j)-Phi_each(i) @L73. Output assembly (L86-L106): NumFreq=length(fre)+length(freq_low) @L89, NumDir=1 @L90, PeakPeriod=1/peakf @L91, Freq=[freq_low; fre] @L92, Dire=0.0 @L93, Amp1=[anm_low; Amp_each] @L94, Eng1=0.5*Amp^2 @L95, Phase1 @L96; writes header lines with fprintf (L98-L102) then appends Amp1 and Phase1 matrices via dlmwrite (L103-L104) — FUNWAVE WK_DATA2D/WK_NEW_DATA2D-style spectrum file. Plot section (L109-L144): reconstructs time series over time=0:0.5:500 @L113 (Wave_each @L114, IGW_each @L116, combined WaveIG_each @L119), energy statistics Etotal=sum(spc^2)/16 @L122, Hrms=sqrt(8*Etotal) @L123, Hsig=sqrt(16*Etotal) @L124, E=spc^2/8 @L126; figures saved as plots/windwave_and_IG_2comp.jpg @L137 and plots/wave_plus_IG_2comp.jpg @L144.

verbatim_spans.text: %    for FUNWAVE wind wave and IG wave input
spc=load('SPC_HMO.txt');  % amp in the example is 0.5m, Hmo is 1.4142

unresolved: Header @L12 declares output 'spectrum_random_phase.txt' but the script writes 'spectrum_two_components.txt' @L88 — name mismatch between documentation and code

IGW_each @L116 adds freq_low (a frequency) directly inside the cosine phase argument (OMEGA_nm_low.*time+freq_low+phase_low) — dimensionally inconsistent with the wave synthesis at L114/L119 which use phase only; likely affects only the diagnostic plot, not the written output

Element-wise products like Amp_each.*cos(Omega_each.*time+Phi_each) @L114 multiply column vectors by the row vector time — relies on MATLAB implicit expansion (R2016b+); Wave_total=sum(Wave_each) @L115 then sums over components only if the orientation matches; IGW_total=IGW_each @L117 is not summed at all (single pair case)

The written file mixes fprintf-formatted header/Freq/Dire lines with dlmwrite '-append' data (L98-L104) while fid is still open — fclose happens after dlmwrite @L106; ordering correctness relies on OS-level append semantics

angle (SPC_angle.txt @L29) and Eng1 @L95, lambda @L59, Knm @L71, omega_nm @L61, fre_used/spc_used @L74-L75, Hrms/Hsig/E (L123-L126) are computed but never used in the written output; MATLAB built-in name 'angle' is shadowed
wvnum_omvec is required but absent from this file; the direction file value is not written (Dire hardcoded 0.0 @L93)
